label: The World Chronicle
summary: Jacopo Foresti's universal chronicle in the vernacular edition of Venice, 1491.

claims.statement: Entered as no. 61 in the reconstructed catalogue of Leonardo's books, under Religion, Philosophy and History. Leonardo's wording as rendered there: "the world chronicle".
check_in: Leonardo's autograph book lists: Codex Trivulzianus f. 2r; Codex Atlanticus f. 559r; Madrid Codex II ff. 2v to 3r (which list names this title to be established)

claims.statement: Identified in the reconstruction as Supplementum Chronicarum. The identification of a title in Leonardo's lists with a specific work and edition is an interpretation.
Composition and printing as given in the reconstruction: Composed 1483 · Printed 1483, Italian version 1491.
check_in: ISTC (Incunabula Short Title Catalogue) or Edit16 record for the edition
